Kingdom.name: {=maroonfaction}Maroon Warlords
Kingdom.title: {=UsbwPmYb}Za of Maroon
Kingdom.text: {=qggtvf8Y}The Maroons hold the southeastern extremity of the Aserai lands, where the Jabal al-Kals - the hills of bitterness - run down to the shore of the Bahr al-Yeshm and divide the sultanate from the Empire. In 1080 a large number of Akan freedom fighters already living in those hills launched an assault on the Northern Empire in Calradia, freeing between 300 and 400 enslaved people. They established a new community of free people in the broken country above the coastal road, where imperial cavalry could not follow them. Naquan, Cudjoe's father, was allegedly the one who orchestrated this rebellion. Naquan was succeeded by Cudjoe, the first Za of this group of Maroons.
